FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
Memo. No.893 / 6723(IV) /CSSC/ESTT/2023 Dated: 24.08.2023
In continuation of earlier notification issued under this office
Memo.No.850/6723(IV)/CSSC/ESTT/2023 dtd.11.08.2023, it is notified for information
of all concerned that online uploading of documents by candidates who applied for the
10% seats reserved for para-teachers in connection with 1st SLST(A.T), 2016 for Upper
Primary Level (Except Work Education & Physical Education) which was scheduled to be
closed on 25.08.2023 at 5.p.m is being extended upto 31.08.2023 at 5P.M.
Sd/-
Chairman
West Bengal Central School Service Commission
The West Bengal Central School Service Commission
ACHARYA SADAN: 11 & 11/1, Block-EE, Salt Lake; Kolkata-700091
